title: Kusanagi Nene — Hold Them In Your Mind〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the light's about to change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Why don't we wait for the next one?
We still have plenty of time until we have to meet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Honami invited her to make candles with us because she also seems to be having trouble deciding what to do for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh no... I'm really sorry. I should've asked you about this first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, it's okay.
I mean, I'm a fellow student, so it's not my choice anyway.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, that name... It sounds so familiar...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Where have I heard it before...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, I remember now...! That time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... She helped us out the other day, but I only got to talk to her for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
Talk about a small world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, also... Yoisaki's gonna join us when we go shopping for supplies, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. When we do, I'll be sure to reintroduce you two to each other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yoisaki, huh...? I've technically already met her, but we didn't really speak, it barely counted...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope I can keep a conversation going with her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Hoshino's friends with her, so she's gotta be a sensible person...unlike some people I know... I'll be fine, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get nervous again...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (B-But Hoshino's here, so I should be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I got a message from Kanade yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she said that she's looking forward to meeting you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade's a really nice person, so I'm sure you two will get along just fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was all worried about being able to keep a conversation going with her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to get to know her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As nervous as I am, I'm also starting to look forward to meeting her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Did Hoshino notice how I was feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Is that why she said that?
Was she trying to help me relax...?)
